title: COACHIP intervention library v1 (frozen for R4)

resolution: match by w_id exactly (the sub-row) first, then parent_w_id
level teacher for S5 (the card = rank_in_w 1 among level teacher; the next two teacher-level = other moves), school for S2 'for this school' and S8, sector for S10
W-EXIT-TIME is never a card: it is W-IP-TIME's cause line; its I list is reached only from an S6 row
the client never hard-codes a W to I pairing
rules.split: W-IP-TIME never gets W-IP-NOPLAN's video and the reverse; same for W-GP-* and W-EXIT-*

check_by.text: the first booked visit for the school at least 7 days after the step is set, else set date + 14 days; compared in Asia/Karachi; never under 7
check_by.strip: next 3 graded recordings within 14 days; 2 of 3 = it worked; under 2 = n recordings to come

rules.l2_routing: an English cell with fluency fine and comprehension or listening low never routes to phonics: W-RC / E2 route to the story and vocabulary plans (PHONICS.md §4)
rules.hijje_bridge: every I-PHON-* and I-PHON-NAMES-* starts from the classroom's hijje and tor-jor and bridges to the sound alone, then with its aerab, then blending and segmenting; never 'start phonics from zero' (x-pedagogy 06:47Z; CONVERGENCE §4.10)
copy: gender-neutral, no pronoun for a person, no Urdu verb or adjective agreeing with a person (B12 + v1.7 add)
British spelling, no em dash, no AI tell (B13)
Urdu in Nastaliq script with Urdu digits; chips at most two Urdu words
debrief and check frames are the client's (COPY §D, §S5): the library text carries no 'Try this tomorrow:' prefix

not_in_v1.W-WAIT: wait time is derived, not stored (WEAKNESS_MAP §B W-WAIT); no primary signal on prod; S1 after a term of data
not_in_v1.W-VOICE: children answering alone: FICO-17 form count met by default over 20 children, chorus counted on 12% of forms (WEAKNESS_MAP §B); weak signal; its value reaches the coach through W-Q
not_in_v1.W-REEXP: v4-only indicator with no v3 equivalent on prod; S6 after the v4 switch
not_in_v1.W-COMP: v3 F7 is saturated and never read as comprehension (lead decision of 26 Oct 06:13Z); v4 F9 after the switch; grade 3+
not_in_v1.W-RW: v4 F10 only; no prod signal; after the switch
not_in_v1.I-IP-PARTIAL-3: calibration: a grader-agreement exercise, not a move for a classroom (the lead's catalogue keeps calibration out of v1)

Thresholds use the 26.1%. Fidelity covers 48% of sessions; v3 D5, B9, C8 are supporting signals shown on unlinked recordings, never counted (W3 §A).

interventions.title_en: Coach models the practice step in the teacher's class
interventions.title_ur: کوچ استاد کی جماعت میں خود مشق کا مرحلہ کر کے دکھائے
interventions.what_coach_does:
1. Before the lesson, read the plan's independent_practice_steps line with the teacher and agree the minute it starts (minute 15 of 25, minute 17 of 30).
2. Teach minutes 15 to 23 yourself: say the task in one sentence, the number of items, where to write them, and the time; name a child timekeeper.
3. Walk the aisle; say one specific line to five children, one per row, under 30 seconds each; the teacher follows one row behind and listens.
4. Give the signal at minute 23 and hand the closure check back to the teacher.
5. In the debrief ask what they heard you say at the start and what the room sounded like; write the one step on the card and set the check-by date.
interventions.with_whom: One teacher, in their own class, in a lesson whose plan has an independent move; the teacher watches with one look-for: the task sentence and the time.
interventions.duration: 8 to 10 min inside the period, plus a 10 min debrief

interventions.what_coach_does:
1. Pick a strong teacher (code only, from the coach's scope) or teach yourself; one grade, one FLN or NIETE plan with an independent move.
2. Give every watching teacher one line to fill: 'minute the task was said; was a time said; minutes children worked alone; how many children were checked'.

interventions.title_en: Sector push: every coach models the practice step in three classes by the second Friday
interventions.title_ur: سیکٹر مہم: ہر کوچ دوسرے جمعے تک تین جماعتوں میں خود مشق کا مرحلہ کر کے دکھائے
interventions.what_coach_does:
1. Monday: the RM reads the sector card; for each coach whose scope fires W-IP, send the three-line follow-up (the W, the teacher codes, by Friday); it lands on the coach's home page.
2. Friday coach circle (extended to 90 minutes once): 15 min on the sector's W-IP sentence and its time / no-plan split; 25 min on one classroom moment where the practice was set well (the 'good sounds like' clip from the sector); 40 min in pairs rehearsing I-IP-1, one coach teaching the step, the other the teacher; 10 min each coach names three teacher codes.
3. Set the bar in the room: every coach models the practice step (I-IP-1) in three classes by the second Friday and writes the step on three teacher cards.
4. Fix the follow-up: the RM sits in on one modelled step per coach before the second Friday.
5. Second Friday circle: read the bar (coaches at 3 of 3) and the sector's W-IP share for the 4-week window against the previous one; relative progress, never a ranking.
interventions.with_whom: The sector's coaches. Monday: the RM picks the follow-up template for this move and up to three schools (never a teacher code; the coach finds the codes on their own screen). Friday coach circle: the RM and the sector's coaches in one room, one classroom moment per coach and the check dates due.
interventions.duration: Monday: 10 min per coach for the follow-up. Friday coach circle: 90 min once, then 15 min on the second Friday. One RM sit-in per coach in between.

interventions.title_en: Hard cap: explanation ends at minute 10 (rehearse the stop line)
interventions.title_ur: سخت حد: وضاحت دسویں منٹ پر ختم (رکنے والا جملہ مشق کریں)
interventions.what_coach_does:
1. Show the teacher the split on the card: 'ran out of time' with the minute the last executed move was heard.
2. Agree the clock for a 25 minute period: warm-up 2, explain 6, guided 6, independent 8, exit 3 (for 30: 3, 7, 7, 10, 3). Write '10' as the minute the explanation ends.
3. Rehearse the stop line three times: the sentence the teacher says at minute 10 to move to 'we do', whatever is left unexplained.
4. Ask the teacher to write '10' in the board corner before the lesson starts; set the check-by date.
interventions.with_whom: One teacher, in the debrief after a recording that fired W-IP-TIME.
interventions.duration: 5 min inside a 15 min debrief

Three times, each time the coach says a minute number first ('nine... ten... stop'). The coach listens for the line coming out without an extra explanation attached.

interventions.title_en: A child timekeeper and the three marks on the board
interventions.title_ur: ایک بچہ وقت کا نگران اور بورڈ پر تین نشان
interventions.what_coach_does:
1. Give the teacher the timekeeper card: three marks for the period (10, 17, 25 for 25 minutes), and the child's one line, «ٹائم ختم» (time's up).
2. Pick the routine together: the timekeeper sits in the front row with the teacher's watch or phone clock, says the line at each mark, and the class answers with the attention signal.
3. Rehearse it once in the debrief with the coach as the child.
4. Set the step: the timekeeper is named before the lesson starts, every lesson for two weeks.
interventions.with_whom: One teacher, in the debrief; the routine is set up in the next lesson.
interventions.duration: 5 min in the debrief; 1 min per lesson after

interventions.rehearsal_script_en: The teacher names the timekeeper and gives the instruction: «تم آج وقت کے نگران ہو۔ دس، سترہ اور پچیس پر زور سے کہنا: ٹائم ختم۔» (you are today's timekeeper; at 10, 17 and 25 say loudly: time's up). The coach, as the child, says «ٹائم ختم» and listens for the teacher's next words to be a change of step, not «ایک منٹ اور».

interventions.title_en: Peer observation with one look-for: the minute the explanation ended
interventions.title_ur: ساتھی مشاہدہ، ایک نظر: وضاحت کس منٹ پر ختم ہوئی
interventions.what_coach_does:
1. Pair two teachers of the school whose cards both carry W-IP-TIME; agree a free period each when one can sit in the other's class.
2. Give the watcher one line to fill: 'explanation ended at minute __; practice started at minute __; children worked alone for __ minutes'.
3. After each lesson, the two teachers swap the line and each says the one thing they will change; no other feedback.
4. On the next visit, read both lines and the recordings; write the step on both cards.
interventions.with_whom: Two teachers of one school, each watching one lesson of the other within a week; the coach sets it up and reads the lines on the next visit.
interventions.duration: One period watched each way + 5 min swap; set-up 10 min

interventions.title_en: Co-teaching: the coach runs the practice step, the teacher circulates, then swap
interventions.title_ur: مل کر پڑھانا: کوچ مشق کا مرحلہ چلائے، استاد قطاروں میں چلیں، پھر ادل بدل
interventions.what_coach_does:
1. Before the lesson, agree who does what: the teacher teaches to minute 15; you set the task from the plan's practice line; the teacher walks the rows and checks five copies.
2. At minute 15 say the task sentence, the items, the place and the time; name a timekeeper.
3. While children work, stand at the back and watch the teacher circulate; count the children they check.
4. In the next lesson (same week), swap: the teacher sets the task, you circulate.
5. Debrief both lessons on one card: the step is the teacher setting the task; the check-by date is the second lesson plus 14 days.
interventions.with_whom: One teacher, two lessons in one week, in their own class with a linked plan.
interventions.duration: 10 min inside each of two periods + 10 min debrief

interventions.title_en: A five-item practice slip on the board before the lesson; nothing goes home untried
interventions.title_ur: سبق سے پہلے بورڈ پر پانچ سوالوں کی مشق پرچی؛ بغیر آزمائے کچھ گھر نہیں جاتا
interventions.what_coach_does:
1. Open tomorrow's plan; copy its practice step into five items of the same kind as the guided examples (the slip).
2. Ask the teacher to write the five items in the board corner before the lesson, covered or turned, and to uncover them at minute 15 with the sentence «یہ پانچ خود کرو، چھ منٹ».
3. Say the rule and write it on the card: nothing goes home that has not been tried in class; homework is one more line of the same task, after the closure check.
4. For an FLN reading-hour class, send the plan through the portal's FLN send so the teacher has the practice step on the phone.
interventions.with_whom: One teacher, in the debrief; the slip is prepared together for the next lesson.
interventions.duration: 8 min in the debrief

interventions.what_coach_does:
1. Gather the school's teachers for 30 minutes with tomorrow's plans open on their phones.
2. Five minutes: the school's W-IP-NOPLAN number and the one rule (practice in class first).
3. Fifteen minutes: each teacher reads their plan's practice line aloud, then says it as the class sentence with a time; the group says only whether the time was there.
4. Five minutes: each teacher writes the sentence on a slip to keep on the desk.
5. Five minutes: the step and the same check-by date on every card.

interventions.title_en: Coach models protecting the whole practice time: help one bench, never stop the room
interventions.title_ur: کوچ دکھائے کہ پوری مشق کا وقت کیسے بچایا جائے: ایک بینچ کی مدد، پورا کمرہ کبھی نہ روکیں
interventions.what_coach_does:
1. Before the lesson, agree the prescribed practice minutes from the plan (usually 10) and the minute it starts.
2. Set the task yourself; then, when the first child asks «کیا کرنا ہے؟», go to that bench and answer in one sentence instead of re-explaining to the room; the teacher watches this.
3. Give fast finishers one extra item written in the board corner beforehand.
4. Keep the task running the whole prescribed time; the signal only at the end.
5. In the debrief, name the moment you did not stop the room and ask the teacher to do the same; write the step and the check-by date.
interventions.with_whom: One teacher, in their own class, in a lesson whose plan has a timed practice move.
interventions.duration: 10 min inside the period + 10 min debrief

interventions.title_en: Coach models 'we do': three items, children give the steps
interventions.title_ur: کوچ «ہم کریں» کر کے دکھائے: تین سوال، قدم بچے بتائیں
interventions.what_coach_does:
1. Before the lesson, pick three items of the kind in the plan's guided step; the teacher explains to minute 9.
2. Minute 9 to 15: do item one on the board thinking aloud; for items two and three ask «اگلا قدم کیا ہوگا؟» and name a child by row for each step; repeat the child's step aloud and ask the room to check it with fingers.
3. Catch one wrong step and explain it a second way (a drawing or an object), then ask the same child again.
4. Hand back at minute 15 with «اب خود کرو» only after most fingers were right.
5. Debrief: the step is three items before solo work; write the check-by date.
interventions.with_whom: One teacher, in their own class, in a lesson whose plan has a guided move.
interventions.duration: 6 min inside the period + 10 min debrief

interventions.rehearsal_script_en: The teacher works an imaginary item two: «اگلا قدم کیا ہوگا؟ تیسری قطار، تم بتاؤ۔» (what is the next step? third row, you tell me). The coach, as the child, gives a wrong step; the teacher says «سب دیکھو، کیا یہ ٹھیک ہے؟ انگلی اوپر اگر ٹھیک۔» (everyone look, is this right? finger up if right). The coach listens for the child being asked before the teacher gives the step.

interventions.title_en: Sector workshop on gradual release in the Friday coach circle, with rehearsal and RM sit-ins
interventions.title_ur: جمعے کے کوچ حلقے میں بتدریج ذمہ داری منتقل کرنے پر سیکٹر ورکشاپ، مشق اور آر ایم کے دوروں کے ساتھ
interventions.what_coach_does:
1. Monday: from the sector card, send each coach whose scope fires W-GP the three-line follow-up (the W, the codes, by Friday).
2. Friday coach circle (extended to 2 hours once): 20 min on the sector's W-GP and W-IP numbers; 30 min on I do, we do, you do with one classroom moment where 'we do' was skipped and one where it was done; 50 min in threes rehearsing I-GP-1 (coach, teacher, child) with the roles rotating; 20 min each coach names the three teacher codes they will model it with.
3. Fix the schedule in the room: the RM sits in on one modelled 'we do' per coach before the second Friday.
4. Second Friday circle: read the sector's W-GP share for the 4-week window against the previous one; relative progress, no ranking.
interventions.with_whom: The sector's coaches. Monday: the RM picks the follow-up template for this move and up to three schools (never a teacher code; the coach finds the codes on their own screen). Friday coach circle: the RM and the sector's coaches in one room, one classroom moment per coach and the check dates due.
interventions.duration: Monday: 10 min per coach. Friday coach circle: 2 h once, then 15 min on the second Friday. One RM sit-in per coach in between.

interventions.what_coach_does:
1. Agree the split: the teacher explains to minute 9; you run items one to three with named children by row; the teacher watches two benches and tells you with a hand sign when they see a wrong step.
2. Run the three items; use the teacher's sign to pick the wrong step and show it a second way.
3. Hand back for solo work at minute 15.
4. Next lesson, swap roles: the teacher runs 'we do', you watch two benches.
5. One card for both lessons; the step is three items with named children; check-by date from the second lesson.

The coach listens for the child's step being repeated aloud.

interventions.title_en: 30-minute PLC: turn tomorrow's guided step into three items with named children
interventions.title_ur: تیس منٹ کی پی ایل سی: کل کے «ہم کریں» مرحلے کو تین سوالوں میں بدلیں
interventions.what_coach_does:
1. Five minutes: the school's W-GP-NOPLAN number and the shape ('three items, named children, then solo').
2. Ten minutes: each teacher reads tomorrow's guided step aloud and writes three items for it on a slip.
3. Ten minutes: each rehearses the first item's question with a row named; the group says only whether a row was named.
4. Five minutes: the step and the check-by date on every card.
interventions.with_whom: The teachers of one school and the coach.
interventions.duration: 30 min

interventions.rehearsal_script_ur: ہر استاد: اپنے پہلے سوال کا پہلا سوال، قطار کے ساتھ: «پہلا قدم کیا ہے؟ چوتھی قطار۔» کوچ کے لیے سننے کی بات: ہر جملے میں قطار۔

interventions.title_en: First rule out a late recording; then model a six-minute explanation with one example
interventions.title_ur: پہلے دیر سے شروع ہونے والی ریکارڈنگ کو خارج کریں؛ پھر ایک مثال کے ساتھ چھ منٹ کی وضاحت کر کے دکھائیں
interventions.what_coach_does:
1. Open the recording: if the first 60 seconds already carry a task or a drill, the lesson started before the phone did; the step is 'press record before the warm-up', not an explanation step.
2. If the explanation is truly absent, teach minutes 3 to 9 yourself in the next lesson: the new idea in Urdu with the English term, one worked example thinking aloud, one question after each small step.
3. Hand over at minute 9 for 'we do'.
4. Debrief: the step is one of the two above; write the check-by date.
interventions.with_whom: One teacher, in the debrief and then in their own class.
interventions.duration: 6 min inside the period + 10 min debrief

interventions.rehearsal_script_en: The teacher says the first sentence of tomorrow's explanation with the English term: «آج ہم سیکھتے ہیں کہ دو ہندسوں والے نمبر کیسے جوڑتے ہیں، یعنی addition۔ دیکھو، پہلے اکائی۔» (today we learn how to add two-digit numbers; look, the ones first). The coach listens for the example starting within the first 30 seconds.
interventions.rehearsal_script_ur: استاد کل کی وضاحت کا پہلا جملہ انگریزی اصطلاح کے ساتھ کہیں: «آج ہم سیکھتے ہیں کہ دو ہندسوں والے نمبر کیسے جوڑتے ہیں، یعنی ⁦addition⁩۔ دیکھو، پہلے اکائی۔» کوچ کے لیے سننے کی بات: مثال پہلے تیس سیکنڈ میں شروع ہو۔
interventions.notes: Only module 47 covers the step; no VIDREC module is about explanation on its own. S12 (recording starts late) must be checked before this W reaches a card.

interventions.title_ur: ساتھی مشاہدہ: کیا ریکارڈنگ سبق سے پہلے شروع ہوئی، اور کیا ایک مثال سمجھائی گئی؟
interventions.what_coach_does:
1. Pair the teacher with a colleague; the colleague sits in one lesson with a two-item slip: 'phone recording before the first word: yes/no; worked example on the board by minute 9: yes/no'.
2. Swap roles within the week.
3. The coach reads both slips on the next visit and writes the step on both cards.
interventions.with_whom: Two teachers of one school; the coach sets it up.
interventions.duration: One period each way + 5 min swap

interventions.title_ur: ایک منٹ کی ادلا بدلی اور جانچنے کی ایک چیز کی مشق
interventions.what_coach_does:
1. Show the plan's peer_review move and the minute it sits at (usually after the practice, before the exit).
2. Agree the one thing to check for tomorrow's task (the ones digit; the dots on پ; the full stop).
3. Rehearse the three sentences: swap, the one thing, back.
4. Write the step and the check-by date.

3. Set the step and the check-by date.

interventions.what_coach_does:
1. Play the last two minutes of the teacher's recording (the M): the lesson ends on homework or «سمجھ آ گیا؟ جی».
2. Say NIETE's line once: the last five minutes for children to say or write what they learned, and for the teacher to check it.
3. Write tomorrow's one exit question together on the card (the question the lesson is for, with one right answer or one example).
4. Rehearse it three times: ask, 'everyone writes', read five, name what was right and what was missing.
5. Set the check-by date; the timekeeper calls «تین منٹ» at minute 22 if the teacher has one.
interventions.with_whom: One teacher, in the debrief after a recording that fired W-EXIT.
interventions.duration: 5 min inside a 15 min debrief

interventions.rehearsal_script_ur: ہر استاد اپنے کارڈ کا سوال جماعت کو مخاطب کر کے پڑھیں اور کہیں: «سلیٹ پر لکھو۔ پھر پانچ سلیٹیں اوپر۔» کوچ کے لیے سننے کی بات: ہر جملہ بچوں کے جواب پر ختم ہو۔

interventions.title_en: The three-minute mark: practice before the closure check, and a child who calls it
interventions.title_ur: تین منٹ کا نشان: اختتامی جانچ سے پہلے مشق، اور ایک بچہ جو آواز دے
interventions.what_coach_does:
1. Give the teacher the timekeeper card with the last mark at minute 22 and the child's line «تین منٹ».
2. Agree the rule: when the call comes, the practice stops wherever it is and the exit question is asked; the practice is never extended into the last three minutes.
3. Rehearse once with the coach as the timekeeper.
4. Write the step and the check-by date.
interventions.with_whom: One teacher, in the debrief.
interventions.duration: 5 min in the debrief

interventions.what_coach_does:
1. The coach or a strong teacher (code only) teaches one period; the watchers fill one line: 'minute the practice stopped; minute the exit question was asked; answers read: __'.
2. Fifteen minutes after: read the lines; agree the school's mark (minute 22) and the call.
3. Each teacher rehearses the stop line once; the step goes on every card.

interventions.title_en: Co-teaching: the coach runs the exit check, the teacher reads the five answers, then swap
interventions.title_ur: مل کر پڑھانا: کوچ اختتامی جانچ چلائے، استاد پانچ جواب پڑھیں، پھر ادل بدل
interventions.what_coach_does:
1. Agree the split: the teacher teaches to minute 22; you ask the exit question and run 'everyone writes'; the teacher collects five slates and reads them aloud, naming what was right.
2. Next lesson, swap: the teacher asks and runs it; you read the five.
3. One card for both; the step is the teacher asking and reading; the check-by date from the second lesson.
interventions.with_whom: One teacher, two lessons in one week.
interventions.duration: 3 min inside each of two periods + 10 min debrief

interventions.what_coach_does:
1. Pair two teachers; each watches the last five minutes of one lesson of the other with a two-item slip: 'children answered a question in the last 3 minutes: yes/no; answers read aloud: __'.
2. Swap lines; each says the one thing they will change.
3. The coach reads the slips on the next visit and writes the step.
interventions.with_whom: Two teachers of one school.
interventions.duration: 5 min each way + 5 min swap

interventions.what_coach_does:
1. Play the first minute of the teacher's recording: 'page kholo' or settling noise.
2. Say NIETE's line: a two-minute opening question or game that links what children know to today's lesson.
3. Write tomorrow's question together (one thing from yesterday) and the link sentence.
4. Rehearse three times: the question, three rows named one at a time, the link.
5. Set the check-by date.

4. Write the step: the signal and the sentence at every switch, for two weeks; set the check-by date.

interventions.what_coach_does:
1. Play two of the teacher's questions from the recording that ended in «نا؟» and a chorus «جی».
2. Turn tomorrow's three scripted questions into open ones together (add «کیوں؟», «کیسے پتا؟», «اور کیا ہو سکتا ہے؟»); write them on the card.
3. Rehearse each: ask, silent count to five, a row named, and one follow-up on the answer the coach gives as the child.
4. Set the step and the check-by date.

interventions.what_coach_does:
1. Agree with the teacher that during tomorrow's practice block you will walk the rows and they will follow one row behind.
2. Say one line to five children, one per row: name the thing («تم نے 'د' لکھا»), then the next ten seconds («اب اس پر نقطہ لگاؤ، 'ڈ' بناؤ»); praise the second try, not the child.
3. Say each line within hearing of the phone.
4. Debrief: ask the teacher to repeat two of the five lines; write the step (three lines per lesson) and the check-by date.
interventions.with_whom: One teacher, in their own class, during the independent practice block.
interventions.duration: 8 min inside the period + 10 min debrief

interventions.rehearsal_script_en: The coach holds up an imaginary slate with د for ڈ. The teacher: «تم نے 'د' لکھا، یہاں 'ڈ' چاہیے۔ اوپر ایک 'ط' جیسا نشان لگاؤ، پھر مجھے دکھاؤ۔» (you wrote د; here ڈ is needed; put the small mark on top, then show me). Second try: «دوسری کوشش میں ٹھیک، یہی طریقہ۔» The coach listens for the thing, the next step, and praise on the try.

interventions.what_coach_does:

4. Set the step (two 'how do you know' questions per lesson) and the check-by date.

interventions.title_en: Coach models the bridge in the reading hour: today's hijje with sounds, then tor-jor as blending and segmenting
interventions.title_ur: کوچ پڑھائی کے گھنٹے میں پل بنا کر دکھائے: آج کے ہجے آوازوں کے ساتھ، پھر توڑ جوڑ آوازیں جوڑنے اور توڑنے کے طور پر
interventions.what_coach_does:
1. Before the period, take the teacher's own hijje list for the day (three to five words) and the linked FLN plan; agree you will teach minutes 5 to 15 and the teacher watches for one thing: sound, not name.
2. Hijje with sounds: for each letter say its sound alone, short and clean, then with its aerab («/ب/ ... /بَ/، نام نہیں، آواز»), class echoes, three children say it alone.
3. Tor (break): say the word's sounds apart with a pause («بَ ... س»); jor (join): sweep and say the word («بس»); class, then a row, then one child on a word you have not said whole.
4. Segment back: say a word, children break it on fingers; dictate two words, check three copies.
5. Hand back for the independent block; in the debrief, write the one step (the bridge) on the card and send the grade's FLN plan through the FLN send; set the check-by date.
interventions.with_whom: One grade 1-2 (or 3) teacher, in their own reading hour, with their own hijje list and the linked FLN plan.
interventions.duration: 10 min inside the period + 10 min debrief

interventions.rehearsal_script_en: One exchange, the teacher at the board with «بس»: «'ب' کا نام نہیں، آواز: /ب/۔ زبر کے ساتھ: /بَ/۔ 'س': /س/۔ توڑ: /بَ/ ... /س/۔ جوڑ: بس۔ اب تم: /کَ/ ... /م/؟» The coach, as the child, says «کم». The coach listens for a sound (not «بے»), the pause, the sweep, and a word the teacher did not say whole.
interventions.rehearsal_script_ur: ایک تبادلہ، استاد بورڈ پر «بس» کے ساتھ: «'ب' کا نام نہیں، آواز: /ب/۔ زبر کے ساتھ: /بَ/۔ 'س': /س/۔ توڑ: /بَ/ ... /س/۔ جوڑ: بس۔ اب تم: /کَ/ ... /م/؟» کوچ بچہ بن کر کہے «کم»۔ کوچ کے لیے سننے کی بات: آواز («بے» نہیں)، وقفہ، جوڑ، اور ایسا لفظ جو استاد نے پورا نہیں کہا۔
interventions.notes: Lead decision (26 Oct, 06:45Z): x-analysis measured 21 literacy recordings; explicit sound-level phonics scored 0 on 12, 1 on 8, 2 on 1; what classrooms do is hijje (ہجے: letter names with aerab), and tor-jor (توڑ جوڑ: joining and breaking). Every W-PHON card starts from hijje and tor-jor as the teacher's existing practice and bridges to pure sounds, blending and segmenting; never 'start phonics from zero'. FLN plans are sent via the portal's FLN send (any leader-family role with the portal_fln_share switch; only to teachers in the coach's own scope; logged as a niete_fln_events row). Until the coachip-detector runs, the coach tick is the only check and S5 = 3 is shown beside it; the strip signal detector.F8.stages_heard is the detector's output, never uptake.*.

check_it_worked.by_when: Tick: the first booked visit for the school at least 7 days after the step is set, else the step date + 14 days (Asia/Karachi; SPEC v2 §0.12). check_it_worked.coach_tick: The teacher's hijje in the watched period used sounds, and the tor-jor had a pause and a sweep.

interventions.rehearsal_script_en: «/نَ/ ... /م/ ... /ک/۔ توڑ ہو گیا۔ جوڑ: نمک۔ تیسری قطار: /دَ/ ... /م/؟» The coach says «دم». The coach listens for no letter names anywhere in the exchange.
interventions.rehearsal_script_ur: «/نَ/ ... /م/ ... /ک/۔ توڑ ہو گیا۔ جوڑ: نمک۔ تیسری قطار: /دَ/ ... /م/؟» کوچ کہے «دم»۔ کوچ کے لیے سننے کی بات: پورے تبادلے میں کہیں حرف کا نام نہ ہو۔
interventions.notes: Lead decision (26 Oct, 06:45Z): x-analysis measured 21 literacy recordings; explicit sound-level phonics scored 0 on 12, 1 on 8, 2 on 1; what classrooms do is hijje (ہجے: letter names with aerab), and tor-jor (توڑ جوڑ: joining and breaking). Every W-PHON card starts from hijje and tor-jor as the teacher's existing practice and bridges to pure sounds, blending and segmenting; never 'start phonics from zero'. FLN plans are sent via the portal's FLN send (any leader-family role with the portal_fln_share switch; only to teachers in the coach's own scope; logged as a niete_fln_events row).
interventions.duration_ur: ۱۵ منٹ کی بات چیت میں ۳ منٹ
interventions.with_whom_ur: ایک استاد کے ساتھ، پڑھائی کے گھنٹے کی ریکارڈنگ کے بعد کی بات چیت میں۔

interventions.title_en: 30-minute reading-hour PLC: every grade 1-3 teacher brings tomorrow's hijje list and rehearses the bridge
interventions.title_ur: تیس منٹ کی پڑھائی کے گھنٹے پی ایل سی: پہلی تا تیسری جماعت کے ہر استاد کے کل کے ہجے اور پل کی مشق
interventions.what_coach_does:
1. Five minutes: what the 21-recording read found (sound-level phonics on 1 of 21; hijje and tor-jor on most) and the bridge in one sentence.
2. Five minutes: the coach models one hijje word with sounds and one tor-jor.
3. Fifteen minutes: each teacher does their first hijje word for tomorrow the same way; the group says only 'sound' or 'name'.
4. Five minutes: the step on every card, the grade's FLN plans sent to each phone through the FLN send, one check-by date.
interventions.with_whom: The grade 1-3 reading-hour teachers of one school and the coach, in one room.
interventions.duration: 30 min

interventions.title_en: Sector push in the Friday coach circle: every coach models the hijje-to-sounds bridge in three reading hours by the second Friday
interventions.title_ur: جمعے کے کوچ حلقے میں سیکٹر مہم: ہر کوچ دوسرے جمعے تک تین پڑھائی کے گھنٹوں میں ہجے سے آوازوں تک کا پل کر کے دکھائے
interventions.what_coach_does:
1. Monday: from the sector card, send each coach the three-line follow-up for W-PHON (the W, the grade 1-2 reading-hour teacher codes, by Friday).
2. Friday coach circle (extended to 90 minutes once): 15 min on the 21-recording read (0 on 12, 1 on 8, 2 on 1) and the bridge; 25 min on one classroom moment of hijje with sounds and one of hijje with names, side by side; 40 min in pairs rehearsing I-PHON-1's exchange, coach and teacher roles rotating; 10 min each coach names three teacher codes.
3. Set the bar in the room: every coach models the bridge in three reading hours by the second Friday and sends the grade's FLN plans.
4. The RM sits in on one modelled bridge per coach before the second Friday; second circle reads the bar and the sector's detector share, relative progress only.
interventions.with_whom: The sector's coaches. Monday: the RM picks the follow-up template for this move and up to three schools (never a teacher code; the coach finds the codes on their own screen). Friday coach circle: the RM and the sector's coaches in one room, one classroom moment per coach and the check dates due.
interventions.duration: Monday: 10 min per coach. Friday coach circle: 90 min once, then 15 min on the second Friday. One RM sit-in per coach in between.

interventions.with_whom_ur: سیکٹر کی کوچ ٹیم۔ پیر: آر ایم اس طریقے کے لیے یاد دہانی کا سانچہ اور زیادہ سے زیادہ ۳ اسکول چنے (استاد کا کوڈ کبھی نہیں؛ کوچ کوڈ اپنی اسکرین پر خود دیکھے)۔ جمعہ کا حلقہ: آر ایم اور سیکٹر کی کوچ ٹیم ایک کمرے میں، ہر کوچ کمرۂ جماعت کا ایک لمحہ لائے، اور جن جانچوں کی تاریخ آ گئی ہو وہ دیکھی جائیں۔

interventions.title_en: Assign the letter-sound plans to the stuck grade, by language, through the FLN send
interventions.title_ur: پھنسی ہوئی جماعت کو زبان کے مطابق حروف کی آوازوں کے منصوبے پورٹل سے بھیجیں
interventions.what_coach_does:
1. Read the cell: which grade, which language, how many of how many tested (counts, not percentages, under 10).
2. English, grade 1: send the sound plans (10180 b/p, 10182 a, 10184 d/t, 10198 i, 10201 g/c/k), Jolly Phonics Group 1 (4963) and 11130; grade 2-3: 4717 or 4642 and 10153, 10155, 10212; grade 4-5 still at letter level: 4764, 10215, 10214, 10218.
3. Urdu (letter names E3 low; sounds not measured): grade 1 letter-family plans 10152, 10157, 10158, 10161, 10162, 10164, 10175, 10176, 10177 and 11133; grade 2-3: 5072, 5080, 11219; grade 4-5: 10188, 10190, 10192, 5084.
4. Tell the grade's teachers in one line which plan to run in the next three reading hours and that the next child check reads the same cell.
5. Book I-LS-2 (the modelled routine) with the teacher of the lowest cell within a week.
interventions.with_whom: The grade's reading-hour teachers at the school whose cell fired; the plans go through the portal's FLN send and the coach names the plan in each teacher's next debrief.
interventions.duration: 15 min at the portal + one line to each teacher

interventions.title_en: Coach models the pure-sound routine inside the teacher's hijje: sound of the day, then blend two known sounds
interventions.title_ur: کوچ استاد کے ہجے کے اندر خالص آواز کا معمول کر کے دکھائے: آج کی آواز، پھر دو جانی پہچانی آوازیں جوڑیں
interventions.what_coach_does:
1. Take the day's hijje list; teach minutes 5 to 12: the sound of the day pure (no 'uh'), in its printed forms, class echo, five children alone.
2. Write two known letters beside it; tor-jor one word: sounds apart, then swept; three children blend alone.
3. Hand back; debrief: the step is the sound-first hijje; send the grade's plan; check-by date.
interventions.with_whom: The teacher of the lowest cell, in their own reading hour.
interventions.duration: 7 min inside the period + 8 min debrief

interventions.rehearsal_script_ur: «یہ 'پ' ہے۔ نام نہیں، آواز: /پ/۔ زبر: /پَ/۔ سب۔ ... پہلی قطار، ایک ایک۔» کوچ کے لیے سننے کی بات: «پے» نہ ہو۔
interventions.notes: Lead decision (26 Oct, 06:45Z): x-analysis measured 21 literacy recordings; explicit sound-level phonics scored 0 on 12, 1 on 8, 2 on 1; what classrooms do is hijje (ہجے: letter names with aerab), and tor-jor (توڑ جوڑ: joining and breaking). Every W-PHON card starts from hijje and tor-jor as the teacher's existing practice and bridges to pure sounds, blending and segmenting; never 'start phonics from zero'. Child-result row (P-EGRA): shown at school and grade level first, floor 5 tested children per cell (min_denominator.coach = the cell floor, sector = 10 for a share). First results expected November; empty state until then. Checks are the next visit's cell; the recording strip is the teaching twin's.

interventions.what_coach_does:
1. Read the cell: which grade, which language, how many of how many tested (counts, not percentages, under 10). Names low in Urdu is the only alphabet cell Urdu has; in English read E3 beside E4.
2. Send the same plans as I-LS-1 for that language and grade through the FLN send: Urdu grade 1 letter families (10152, 10157, 10158, 10161, 10162, 10164, 10175, 10176, 10177), grade 2-3 (5072, 5080); English grade 1 (10180, 10182, 10184, 4963), grade 2-3 (4717, 10153).
3. In each teacher's next debrief say the one difference, name and sound, and rehearse one letter: the sound alone, then with its aerab, then the name.
4. Write the step and the check-by date; the next child check reads the same cell.
interventions.with_whom: The grade's reading-hour teachers at the school whose cell fired, each in their own debrief at the next visit; the plans go through the portal's FLN send.
interventions.duration: 15 min at the portal + 4 min in each debrief

interventions.rehearsal_script_en: The teacher at the board with one letter: «'م' کی آواز: /م/۔ زبر کے ساتھ: /مَ/۔ سب: /م/۔ دوسری قطار اکیلے: /م/۔» The coach, as the class, repeats and listens for a short clean sound with no 'uh' and no «میم».
interventions.rehearsal_script_ur: استاد بورڈ پر ایک حرف کے ساتھ: «'م' کی آواز: /م/۔ زبر کے ساتھ: /مَ/۔ سب: /م/۔ دوسری قطار اکیلے: /م/۔» کوچ جماعت بن کر دہرائے اور سنے: چھوٹی صاف آواز، بغیر «اَ» کے، اور کہیں «میم» نہ ہو۔
interventions.notes: Added at the freeze (CONVERGENCE §4.8; PANEL_R2 §7.8). W-LN never reaches S1. The plans are I-LS-1's for the same language and grade: name knowledge does not transfer to reading, sound knowledge does (Piasta and Wagner 2010; PHONICS.md §1.1 E3 row 'spend the time on sounds'). Urdu letter sounds are not measured (E4 Urdu is a gap), so for Urdu the E3 cell is the trigger and the W-PHON recording check is the twin.

interventions.rehearsal_script_en: «توڑ: /کِ/ ... /تا/ ... /ب/۔ جوڑ: کتاب۔ اب نیا، چوتھی قطار: /جَ/ ... /ل/؟» The coach listens for the pause and a word the teacher did not say whole.
interventions.rehearsal_script_ur: «توڑ: /کِ/ ... /تا/ ... /ب/۔ جوڑ: کتاب۔ اب نیا، چوتھی قطار: /جَ/ ... /ل/؟» کوچ کے لیے سننے کی بات: وقفہ اور ایسا لفظ جو استاد نے پورا نہیں کہا۔
interventions.notes: Full battery only. Child-result row (P-EGRA): shown at school and grade level first, floor 5 tested children per cell (min_denominator.coach = the cell floor, sector = 10 for a share). First results expected November; empty state until then. Checks are the next visit's cell; the recording strip is the teaching twin's. FLN plans are sent via the portal's FLN send (any leader-family role with the portal_fln_share switch; only to teachers in the coach's own scope; logged as a niete_fln_events row). Syllable-only work (ki-taab) caps the detector at 1; the segmenting stage must reach single sounds (W2 §3).
interventions.duration_ur: پورٹل پر ۱۵ منٹ اور ہر استاد کے لیے ایک سطر
interventions.with_whom_ur: جس اسکول اور جماعت کا خانہ نکلا ہو، وہاں اس جماعت میں پڑھائی کا گھنٹہ جو بھی استاد لے۔

interventions.title_en: Coach models the blending routine on the teacher's tor-jor words: dots, taps, sweep, a new word
interventions.title_ur: کوچ استاد کے توڑ جوڑ کے الفاظ پر آوازیں جوڑنے کا معمول کر کے دکھائے: نقطے، انگلی، جوڑ، نیا لفظ
interventions.what_coach_does:
1. Take the day's tor-jor words; teach minutes 8 to 15: write the word, a dot under each sound, tap and say each with a pause, sweep and say the word; class, then a row, then one child on a word you have not said; finish with a word nobody has seen.
2. The teacher watches for one thing: the dots under single sounds, not syllables.
3. Debrief: the step; send the plan; check-by date.
interventions.with_whom: The teacher of the lowest cell, in their own reading hour.
interventions.duration: 7 min inside the period + 8 min debrief

teacher_action_step.step_ur: کل کے توڑ جوڑ میں ہر آواز کے نیچے نقطہ، وقفے سے انگلی، جوڑ، پھر ایک بچہ نیا لفظ جوڑے

interventions.rehearsal_script_en: «(three dots) /سَ/ ... /ب/ ... /ق/۔ (sweep) سبق۔ تیسری قطار: (three dots) /نَ/ ... /م/ ... /ک/؟» The coach listens for a dot per sound and the sweep.
interventions.rehearsal_script_ur: «(تین نقطے) /سَ/ ... /ب/ ... /ق/۔ (انگلی پھیر کر) سبق۔ تیسری قطار: (تین نقطے) /نَ/ ... /م/ ... /ک/؟» کوچ کے لیے سننے کی بات: ہر آواز کا نقطہ اور جوڑ۔
interventions.notes: Full battery only. Lead decision (26 Oct, 06:45Z): x-analysis measured 21 literacy recordings; explicit sound-level phonics scored 0 on 12, 1 on 8, 2 on 1; what classrooms do is hijje (ہجے: letter names with aerab), and tor-jor (توڑ جوڑ: joining and breaking). Every W-PHON card starts from hijje and tor-jor as the teacher's existing practice and bridges to pure sounds, blending and segmenting; never 'start phonics from zero'. Child-result row (P-EGRA): shown at school and grade level first, floor 5 tested children per cell (min_denominator.coach = the cell floor, sector = 10 for a share). First results expected November; empty state until then. Checks are the next visit's cell; the recording strip is the teaching twin's.

interventions.what_coach_does:
1. Read the cell: if errors are many, treat it as W-DEC first (I-DEC-1); if children are slow but accurate, assign fluency.
2. Urdu: grade 1: 11585, 11589 (کہانی روانی); grade 2: 11608, 11613; grade 5: 11634, 11637. English: grade 1: 11649, 11651; grade 2: 11673, 11685; grade 4: 11689, 11699 (Fluency).
3. One line to the grade's teachers: the plan, three reading hours, echo then choral then paired then one-minute timed on the same text.
4. Book I-ORF-2 with the teacher of the lowest cell.
interventions.with_whom: The grade's reading-hour teachers at the school whose cell fired.
interventions.duration: 15 min at the portal + one line to each teacher

interventions.title_en: Coach models the fluency routine: echo, choral, paired, timed
interventions.title_ur: کوچ روانی کا معمول کر کے دکھائے: بازگشت، اجتماعی، جوڑی، وقت کے ساتھ
interventions.what_coach_does:
1. Take the day's story; teach minutes 8 to 18: echo one sentence with expression, choral the paragraph, benchmates read it to each other three times swapping, one timed minute with a word count written on the slate.
2. The teacher watches for one thing: every child reading aloud, not listening.
3. Debrief: the step; send the plan; check-by date.
interventions.with_whom: The teacher of the lowest cell, in their own reading hour.
interventions.duration: 10 min inside the period + 8 min debrief

interventions.title_en: Assign the (فہم) and (Comprehension) story plans; an English fluent-not-understanding cell gets vocabulary and listening, never phonics
interventions.title_ur: فہم والی کہانیوں کے منصوبے بھیجیں؛ انگریزی میں روانی ٹھیک مگر سمجھ کم ہو تو ذخیرۂ الفاظ اور سننا، حروف کی آوازیں کبھی نہیں
interventions.what_coach_does:
1. Read the cell with E2 beside it: low E11 with fine E2 = reading strategy; low on both = language (vocabulary, listening), loudest in English.
2. Urdu strategy: grade 1: 11595, 11596 (کہانی فہم); grade 2: 11604, 11611; grade 5: 11641, 11644. English strategy: grade 1: 11650, 11652; grade 2: 11674, 11686; grade 4: 11690, 11702 (Comprehension).
3. English language cell: the same (Comprehension) story plans run as read-alouds with questions before, during and after, three new words a day used in a sentence; videos 107, 108, 38; never modules 32-35 or 61.
4. One line to the grade's teachers: the plan, three reading hours, one strategy named and modelled.
5. Book I-RC-2 with the teacher of the lowest cell.
interventions.with_whom: The grade's reading-hour teachers at the school whose cell fired.
interventions.duration: 15 min at the portal + one line to each teacher

interventions.title_en: Assign the grade's FLN numeracy plans and the concrete-pictorial-abstract videos to the stuck grade
interventions.title_ur: پھنسی ہوئی جماعت کو ⁦FLN⁩ حساب کے منصوبے اور ٹھوس، تصویری، علامتی ویڈیوز بھیجیں
interventions.what_coach_does:
1. Read the cell; once S13 publishes the M1-M8 names, read which subtask (number identification, addition, word problems) is lowest.
2. Assign the grade's FLN numeracy plans for that topic through the FLN send (the numeracy corpus has 270 plans; FLN_TOPICS.md lists their count but not their topics, so the coach picks from the portal's LessonList by grade and topic).
3. Send one video to the grade's teachers: 14 Number Sense (tens and ones), 16 Solve Basic Operations (carrying with sticks), 13 Drawing Diagrams (comparison), or 54 Misconceptions (wrong answers), matched to the lowest subtask.
4. One line to the teachers: the plan, three maths periods, objects before symbols and «کیسے کیا؟» before «غلط».
5. Book I-NUM-2 with the teacher of the lowest cell.
interventions.with_whom: The grade's maths teachers at the school whose cell fired.
interventions.duration: 15 min at the portal + one line to each teacher

3. Debrief: the step; check-by date.

interventions.title_en: The hijje time done with sounds: the sound alone, then with its aerab; children repeat; blend before reading
interventions.title_ur: ہجے کا وقت آوازوں سے: پہلے صرف آواز، پھر اعراب کے ساتھ؛ بچے دہرائیں؛ پڑھنے سے پہلے جوڑیں
interventions.what_coach_does:
1. Play the hijje moment from the recording («بے زبر با ... بس») and say the one difference: the name is 'بے', the sound is /ب/; with zabar, /بَ/.
2. Rehearse one word of three sounds from tomorrow's hijje list: the teacher says each sound alone, then with its aerab, the coach (as the class) repeats, the teacher blends it aloud, then asks the coach to read it.
3. Send the grade's FLN sound plan through the FLN send and one video (32 or 43 for Urdu, 33 or 61 for English).
4. Write the step and the check-by date.
interventions.with_whom: One grade 1-2 teacher, in the debrief after a reading-hour recording.
interventions.duration: 4 min inside a 15 min debrief

interventions.rehearsal_script_en: One word, three sounds, blended: «'ب' کی آواز: /ب/۔ زبر کے ساتھ: /بَ/۔ سب: /ب/۔ 'س': /س/۔ سب: /س/۔ جوڑو: بَ ... س ... بس۔ اب پڑھو: بس۔» The coach repeats as the class and listens for a short clean sound first, no 'uh', and no «بے» or «سین» anywhere.
interventions.rehearsal_script_ur: ایک لفظ، تین آوازیں، جوڑ کر: «'ب' کی آواز: /ب/۔ زبر کے ساتھ: /بَ/۔ سب: /ب/۔ 'س': /س/۔ سب: /س/۔ جوڑو: بَ ... س ... بس۔ اب پڑھو: بس۔» کوچ جماعت بن کر دہرائے اور سنے: پہلے چھوٹی صاف آواز، بغیر «اَ» کے، اور کہیں «بے» یا «سین» نہ ہو۔
interventions.notes: Lead decision (26 Oct, 06:45Z): x-analysis measured 21 literacy recordings; explicit sound-level phonics scored 0 on 12, 1 on 8, 2 on 1; what classrooms do is hijje (ہجے: letter names with aerab), and tor-jor (توڑ جوڑ: joining and breaking). Every W-PHON card starts from hijje and tor-jor as the teacher's existing practice and bridges to pure sounds, blending and segmenting; never 'start phonics from zero'. Same bridge as I-PHON-1 and I-PHON-2, scoped to the hijje time; see those for the full modelled period. FLN plans are sent via the portal's FLN send (any leader-family role with the portal_fln_share switch; only to teachers in the coach's own scope; logged as a niete_fln_events row).

Send one module matched to the language of the recording: 32 'Phonic strategies part 1' or 43 'ارکان سازی' for Urdu; 33 'Blending and Segmenting' or 61 'Building phonic foundations' for English; one line: 'listen for the moment the teacher says a sound, not a name, and what the children do next'.

3. Set the step and the check-by date.

interventions.what_coach_does:
1. Five minutes: the 21-recording read (names on most, sounds on 1) and the one difference: name versus sound, with aerab.
2. Five minutes: the coach converts one hijje word («بے زبر با، سین: بس» to «/بَ/ ... /س/: بس») and blends it.
3. Fifteen minutes: each teacher takes one word from tomorrow's hijje list, says its sounds with aerab, the group repeats as the class, the teacher blends it; the group says only 'sound' or 'name'.
4. Five minutes: the step on every card; the grade's FLN sound plans sent to each phone; one check-by date.
interventions.with_whom: The grade 1-3 reading-hour teachers of one school and the coach.
interventions.duration: 30 min

check_it_worked.look_for: Each teacher's next reading-hour recording has sounds with aerab in the hijje and a child's sound. detector.F8.stages_heard >= 1 AND detector.letter_name_routine_only = false on each of the next 3 literacy recordings, 2 of 3; the W id predicate IS letter_name_routine_only, so 'W-PHON-NAMES absent' plus one stage heard is the pass.
check_it_worked.by_when: Tick: the first booked visit for the school at least 7 days after the step is set, else the step date + 14 days (Asia/Karachi; SPEC v2 §0.12). Strip: the next 3 graded recordings within 14 days of the step; 2 of 3 = it worked; under 2 = n recordings to come; a partial counts as progress to praise.

check_it_worked.look_for_ur: ہر استاد کی پڑھائی کے گھنٹے کی اگلی ریکارڈنگ میں ہجے اعراب کے ساتھ آوازوں سے ہوں اور بچوں میں سے کسی کی آواز میں حرف کی آواز سنائی دے۔ اگلی ۳ پڑھائی کی ریکارڈنگز میں سے ۲ میں ⁦detector.F8.stages⁩_⁦heard⁩ >= ⁦1⁩ ⁦AND⁩ ⁦detector.letter⁩_⁦name⁩_⁦routine⁩_⁦only⁩ = ⁦false⁩ ہو؛ ⁦W⁩ کی شرط ⁦letter⁩_⁦name⁩_⁦routine⁩_⁦only⁩ ہی ہے، اس لیے ⁦W-PHON-NAMES⁩ کا نہ ہونا اور ایک مرحلہ سنائی دینا کامیابی ہے۔

interventions.notes: Lead decision (26 Oct, 06:45Z): x-analysis measured 21 literacy recordings; explicit sound-level phonics scored 0 on 12, 1 on 8, 2 on 1; what classrooms do is hijje (ہجے: letter names with aerab), and tor-jor (توڑ جوڑ: joining and breaking). Every W-PHON card starts from hijje and tor-jor as the teacher's existing practice and bridges to pure sounds, blending and segmenting; never 'start phonics from zero'. Overlaps I-PHON-3; where both fire, run one PLC and set both steps. FLN plans are sent via the portal's FLN send (any leader-family role with the portal_fln_share switch; only to teachers in the coach's own scope; logged as a niete_fln_events row).
interventions.duration_ur: ۳۰ منٹ
interventions.with_whom_ur: ایک اسکول کے اساتذہ جو جماعت ۱ سے ۳ میں پڑھائی کا گھنٹہ لیں، اور کوچ۔

interventions.title_en: Friday coach circle: one hijje-with-names moment and one hijje-with-sounds moment, side by side
interventions.title_ur: جمعے کا کوچ حلقہ: ناموں والے ہجے کا ایک لمحہ اور آوازوں والے ہجے کا ایک لمحہ، ساتھ ساتھ
interventions.what_coach_does:
1. Monday: from the sector card, send each coach whose scope fires W-PHON-NAMES the three-line follow-up (the W, the grade 1-2 reading-hour teacher codes, by Friday).
2. Friday coach circle, 30 min: play one classroom moment of hijje with names («بے زبر با») and one of hijje with sounds («/بَ/») from the sector, side by side; each coach says in one sentence what the children did differently in the second.
3. Each coach rehearses the one-word exchange as the teacher; the RM listens for sounds only.
4. Each coach names one teacher code to model it with before the next circle.
interventions.with_whom: The sector's coaches. Monday: the RM picks the follow-up template for this move and up to three schools (never a teacher code; the coach finds the codes on their own screen). Friday coach circle: the RM and the sector's coaches in one room, one classroom moment per coach and the check dates due.
interventions.duration: Monday: 5 min per coach. Friday coach circle: 30 min.

interventions.debrief_script_en: In {n} of {d} reading-hour recordings across the sector words were built from letter names and no child said a sound. By Friday: turn one hijje word into sounds with a teacher at each school named on your Monday note, and bring one hijje moment to the circle.
interventions.debrief_script_ur: سیکٹر کی {d} پڑھائی کے گھنٹے کی ریکارڈنگز میں سے {n} میں الفاظ حروف کے ناموں سے بنے اور کسی بچے نے آواز نہیں کہی۔ جمعے تک: پیر کی یاد دہانی میں نامزد ہر اسکول کے ایک استاد کے ساتھ ہجے کا ایک لفظ آوازوں میں بدلیں اور ہجے کا ایک لمحہ حلقے میں لائیں۔

interventions.rehearsal_script_en: Coaches in turn, as the teacher: «/نَ/ ... /م/ ... /ک/: نمک۔ اب تم: /دَ/ ... /م/؟» The RM listens for no letter names.
interventions.rehearsal_script_ur: کوچ باری باری استاد بن کر: «/نَ/ ... /م/ ... /ک/: نمک۔ اب تم: /دَ/ ... /م/؟» آر ایم کے لیے سننے کی بات: کوئی حرف کا نام نہ ہو۔
interventions.notes: Lead decision (26 Oct, 06:45Z): x-analysis measured 21 literacy recordings; explicit sound-level phonics scored 0 on 12, 1 on 8, 2 on 1; what classrooms do is hijje (ہجے: letter names with aerab), and tor-jor (توڑ جوڑ: joining and breaking). Every W-PHON card starts from hijje and tor-jor as the teacher's existing practice and bridges to pure sounds, blending and segmenting; never 'start phonics from zero'. Runs in both RM moments (Monday follow-up in the debrief_script fields; Friday coach circle). The 90-minute push for the whole W-PHON family is I-PHON-4.
interventions.duration_ur: پیر: ہر کوچ پر ۵ منٹ۔ جمعے کا حلقہ: ۳۰ منٹ۔
interventions.with_whom_ur: سیکٹر کی کوچ ٹیم۔ پیر: آر ایم اس طریقے کے لیے یاد دہانی کا سانچہ اور زیادہ سے زیادہ ۳ اسکول چنے (استاد کا کوڈ کبھی نہیں؛ کوچ کوڈ اپنی اسکرین پر خود دیکھے)۔ جمعہ کا حلقہ: آر ایم اور سیکٹر کی کوچ ٹیم ایک کمرے میں، ہر کوچ کمرۂ جماعت کا ایک لمحہ لائے، اور جن جانچوں کی تاریخ آ گئی ہو وہ دیکھی جائیں۔

interventions.title_en: Monthly shared lesson: executed, partial or not done on the practice move
interventions.title_ur: ماہانہ مشترکہ سبق: مشق کا مرحلہ ہوا، ادھورا ہوا یا نہیں ہوا
interventions.what_coach_does:
1. Before the first Friday of the month, the RM picks one sector recording with a linked plan and a timed practice move and master-codes minutes 12 to 25 (the independent and exit moves) with the lead; the AI grader's verdict sits beside the master code.
2. Friday coach circle: all coaches listen to the same stretch; each writes a verdict on two moves (independent: executed / partial / not_done, with the minutes they think children worked; exit: done / not done) before anyone speaks.
3. The RM shows the master code, then the grader's verdict, worked_minutes band and evidence quote.
4. The gaps between coaches, and between coaches and the master code, are the agenda: what counts as 'partial'.
5. Agree one sentence for the sector: 'partial means the task was set but ran under half the prescribed time or turned into chorus'. No flag, no ranking.
interventions.with_whom: Friday coach circle: the RM and the sector's coaches in one room, one classroom moment per coach and the check dates due, the first Friday of each month (the monthly shared lesson)
interventions.duration: Friday coach circle, 45 min, monthly

check_it_worked.look_for: Not a recording check: the next month's sheet shows coaches' verdicts on the practice move agreeing with the master code on 4 of 5 moves.
check_it_worked.by_when: Tick: the first booked visit for the school at least 7 days after the step is set, else the step date + 14 days (Asia/Karachi; SPEC v2 §0.12).
